videos.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
videos.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings shows every day life of Grizzy the bear who takes advantage of the fact that Forest Ranger leaves his snug house in the middle of huge canadian forest and moves in there to live in comfort. Grizzy enjoys delicious food, TV, couch and all other blessings of civilization to the full. But the lemmings have set sights on the house as well and they will stop at nothing to kick Grizzy out. Grizzy does not want to lose his new comfortable life, and this is how an endless struggle for the house starts which fills their days with fun and amazing adventures. They do their best at

videos.title: Pokémon Horizons: The Series
videos.description: Regardez ce samedi 21 novembre sur BBC2 à 08:15 le programme "Pokémon Horizons: The Series" produit en Japon en 2025. D'une durée de 20 min ce programme est adapté à tous publics.

videos.title: Winx Club: The Magic Is Back
videos.description: Regardez ce samedi 21 novembre sur BBC2 à 08:35 le programme "Winx Club: The Magic Is Back" produit en Italie en 2025. D'une durée de 25 min ce programme est adapté à tous publics.

videos.title: The Next Step: Cheer
videos.description: The Next Step's Kenzie salvages what is left of a broken cheer team, desperate to prove that she can bult this rag-tag group of athletes into a contender for the nationals.

videos.title: Newsround
videos.description: Unique programme that provides children with all the latest news and current events from UK and around the globe, educating and informing them. Young viewers will have a chance to hear all the important stories, see the pictures and videos, and find out what is going on. This children's news programme also deals with various serious topics and sensitive issues that are affecting young people and the world.

videos.title: Blue Peter
videos.description: Longest running children's programme in the world, featuring current affairs, competitions, celebrity interviews, popular culture and 'do-it-yourself' instructions on creating arts and crafts trinkets from everyday household items. A multitude of presenters have hosted the show, joined in the studio by their pet dogs and cats, which have become firm favourites with family audiences. Young invitees who share their skills or stories of bravery win a coveted 'Blue Peter' badge, The show, which has a nautical title and theme tune, was launched in October 1958 by its first producer Biddy Baxter, an

videos.title: Deadly 60
videos.description: Deadly 60 is a British wildlife documentary series aimed at children. It follows zoologist Steve Backshall, as he travels the world with his camera crew, introducing some of the world's deadliest creatures, from insects and reptiles, to huge mammal predators. Watch him as he explores the traits of these animals, and find out which are the ones he considers the most dangerous. His selection includes wolfs, leopards , anacondas, crocodiles and sharks, but also some surprises like giant ants, sea lions and squids.

videos.title: Gardeners' World
videos.description: Monty celebrates the rewards of winter gardening – sharing ideas, inspiration and timely jobs to keep gardeners busy now, while reminding us that warmer days lie ahead. At Longmeadow, he has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses. Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment, where there's always plenty to do during the colder months, including some clever composting. Jamie Butterworth takes a tour of one of Somerset's most imaginative topiary gardens. In Belfast, a local community tells the tale of how their once neglected alleyway has become their pride and joy.

videos.title: Naturewatch
videos.description: Chris Packham is joined by Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin for another lively, curiosity-fuelled adventure into the wonders of Britain's wildlife, uncovering nature's most fascinating secrets and surprising stories. This week, the team dives into some intriguing autumn mysteries: why don't seals drown? What is the UK's most deadly mushroom? And what extraordinary creature has the power to keep autumn leaves alive? Expect surprising discoveries, weird and wonderful wildlife facts and plenty of questions along the way!

videos.title: My Life at Christmas
videos.description: Anita Rani pays a Christmas visit to Baroness Floella Benjamin, a pivotal figure to generations of young TV viewers. Born in Trinidad and Tobago, Floella arrived in London at the age of ten as part of the Windrush generation. Together, they retrace that journey and reflect on Dame Floella's extraordinary life shaped by faith and the festive season: from stage actor and iconic Play School presenter to businesswoman, child rights campaigner, dame and baroness, and even playing a role in King Charles III's coronation.

videos.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
videos.description: Marcus plans to bring in some ducks, but things aren't as simple as they seem as he heads out onto the lake to create a new home for them. Heading to Devon, he discovers the perfect breed for the smallholding and picks up some top tips and tricks on how to rear them. Back on the farm, the bounty of the kitchen garden inspires a visit to a local community fridge to learn more about how it works, before a neighbour pops over to give him a lesson on what is edible and growing wild in the hedgerows and bushes that surround the smallholding. Once the new ducks arrive and are safely in their new hom

videos.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
videos.description: Nadiya shares her simple celebratory bakes for every day of the week, which make special occasions a whole lot easier. She gets the party started with a playful crowd pleaser inspired by her travels to New Orleans. Her take on a Louisiana seafood boil is bursting with succulent langoustines, scattered with mussels and clams and bathed in a zesty, buttery sauce. Next up is a traditional Eastern European sweet bread known as babka. This simple-but-spectacular loaf has twisted layers of soft, sweet buttery bread and is bursting with joyful rainbow sprinkles – a clever alternative to cake designed

videos.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
videos.description: Screen adaptation of Oscar Wilde's celebrated play in which two Victorian gentlemen both adopt a double identity under the name of Ernest and end up in trouble when they both turn up at the same country house one weekend.

videos.title: Strangers on a Train
videos.description: Alfred Hitchcock's suspense classic about two men who plot a perfect murder. When tennis pro Guy Haines meets smooth-talking Bruno Antony in the bar of a train, he finds the stranger sympathetic with his desire to be rid of his clinging wife. The sinister Bruno then proposes that they swap murders: Bruno will murder Guy's wife, and Guy will do away with Bruno's father. From Patricia Highsmith's novel.

videos.title: Flog It!
videos.description: The programme comes from the Platform in Morecambe, Lancashire, which in its day was the main station bringing holidaymakers to the town. Antiques experts Charles Hanson and Catherine Southon find treasures to take to auction, including a vintage Rolex watch. Paul Martin discovers the rags-to-riches story of the town's most famous son – Eric Morecambe.

videos.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
videos.description: Broadcasting legend Bob Harris and queen of motor sports Suzi Perry burn rubber across south east England in a racy 1974 Ford Escort RS 2000. But can they flip antiques for profit? Steering them in the right direction are doyens Margie Cooper and Raj Bisram, both veteran road trippers and rivals to the core. What starts out as a hunt for music and travel collectibles changes tack very early on. Bob falls for a pair of romantic champagne flutes in a love heart stand, while Suzy steps back in time when she discovers a Japanese glass fishing float. Along the way, they learn to raise their profile

videos.title: The Eagle Has Landed
videos.description: All-action World War II adventure. On the morning of 6 November 1943, the military authorities in Berlin receive a simple message – 'The Eagle Has Landed'. In a daring kidnap attempt, a small force of crack German paratroopers are poised to snatch Winston Churchill and return with him to Germany. If they succeed in their mission, it could alter the course of the war. Who can stop them?

videos.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 3
videos.description: A collection of 40 rarely seen musical moments that don't often get to escape from the BBC vaults. Featuring Roachford on The Roland Rat Show, David Bowie on Friday Night with Jonathan Ross, Mary J Blige appearing on Davina McCall's chat show and one of Gloria Estefan's several star turns on the Royal Variety Show over the years.

videos.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 2
videos.description: Another deep dive into the BBC's music archives, where the musical map is pointed away from Top of the Pops on a quest to uncover 40 rarely seen performances and hidden gems. Featuring Bronski Beat's first BBC performance of Smalltown Boy, Rihanna's rockier version of Umbrella, Sophie Ellis-Bextor covering Pulp's Do You Remember the First Time? and Kate Bush pairing up for a tango during Hounds of Love. These tucked-away treats and many, many more make this a journey that musical fans are certain to treasure.

videos.title: Blue Velvet
videos.description: When the discovery of a severed ear in a field leads a small-town college student to a bewitching nightclub singer, he finds himself lost in a dark underworld of fear and depravity. A disturbing, unique exploration of the dark side of American suburbia from director David Lynch.

videos.title: Question Time
videos.description: Politicians, public figures and celebrities debate the biggest issues of the week and contemporary matters in front of a live studio audience around the UK. The guests are faced with questions from members of the public and invited to give their opinions. Since Question Time was first broadcast in 1979, it has welcomed onto its panels countless Members of Parliament and other notable guests including well-known journalists, actors, authors, comedians, business and religious leaders. It has given key insights into important topics and prompted necessary discourse.

videos.title: Honey
videos.description: Martha is annoyed after Kurt steals their joint credit for locating Kamilla, and she vows to gain access to the scientist alone. A competitive Kurt promises to do the same. Friedrich is ordered by his boss Schimmel to ramp up his efforts to locate Greta, believing she is the key to the Hermann Metzl case. Eager for a win, Martha and Kurt attempt to insinuate their way into Friedrich's confidence to find Greta. Stung by his reaction, Martha steals a prized possession.

videos.title: This Is BBC Two
videos.description: Regardez ce dimanche 22 novembre sur BBC2 à 05:00 le programme "This Is BBC Two" produit en Ecossais en 2026. D'une durée de 145 min ce programme est adapté à tous publics.

videos.title: Countryfile
videos.description: Hamza Yassin heads to a secret location in Scotland's Southern Uplands to join a dedicated team on an exciting mission to protect the fastest animal in the world – the peregrine falcon. Getting up close to three chicks, he discovers how DNA sampling is helping tackle the theft of these remarkable birds. Along the way, the programme revisits memorable Countryfile wildlife encounters, from dolphins off Anglesey to spectacular starling murmurations at Newport Wetlands.

videos.title: BBC News
videos.description: The latest news from the BBC,which is designed to inform you on current affairs. The BBC is aims to be a totally impartial public service broadcaster, and was established by Royal Charter. The BBC is funded by a licence fee paid by British households, and is regulated by Ofcom. They aim to create high-quality content, in order to inform and educate, but also entertain, their audience Millions of people from all over the world watch content produced by the BBC, and they are well respected as a media company. It was founded in 1922, with its headquarters in Westminster, London.

videos.title: Landward
videos.description: A special episode from north Sutherland at the top of the Scottish mainland. Dougie steps out into the Flow Country, a vast expanse of blanket peat bog, where he charts the changes in its land use and its recent designation as a Unesco World Heritage site. Arlene catches up with sheep farmer Joyce Campbell to see how she has made the switch from traditional hill farming to regenerative agriculture. Arlene also visits Strath Halladale, where she meets a man who gave up city life to run the family croft 37 years ago. She finds out how he has built a thriving timber business and brought jobs to t

videos.title: Beechgrove Repotted
videos.description: Indonesian cook and gardener Dina Watt takes us from garden fork to table fork. Dina grows to cook in her Banchory garden, creating tasty and innovative dishes with her homegrown produce and adding an Indonesian twist to her Scottish-grown crops. Dina also introduces us to the Maxwell Centre in the heart of Coldside, Dundee, where they teach the local children to grow, care for, harvest and then eat what they have grown.

videos.title: A Cook Abroad
videos.description: Scottish chef Tony Singh travels to India, the country of his ancestors, to trace his family roots and discover whether his mum's Punjabi cooking is the real deal. He begins his journey in Amritsar, which is draped in lights for the festival of Diwali, before braving the treacherous Grand Trunk Road to Delhi, a place Tony has only ever visited twice. Along the way, he fulfils a boyhood dream to meet the Nihang, nomadic Sikh warriors whose cooking techniques are legendary. He receives an exclusive invite to eat and cook with a Maharaja and, as his waistline tightens thanks to the rich Punjabi d

videos.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
videos.description: Paris is home to more award-winning pastry chefs than anywhere else in the world. Here, the day revolves around patisserie. Morning begins with the buttery flakes of a croissant. At midday, a baguette tucked under the arm signals lunch. And by the afternoon, mouthwatering sweet treats are savoured like miniature works of art. Resistance is futile, and Eva is seduced by the Paris-Brest, a rum baba, the macaron, a mango cake and dahlia, to name just a few.

videos.title: The Man Who Never Was
videos.description: Espionage thriller in which a British intelligence officer plans an elaborate hoax in the spring of 1943 to fool the Germans into thinking the Allies are about to invade Greece, not Sicily. The plan calls for the navy to float a dead body carrying false identification and information so that the Germans will pick it up. The first part of the mission succeeds, but will the Nazis take the bait?

videos.title: Homes Under the Hammer
videos.description: In Scotland, Martel encounters a house with a safety order attached to it, which means certain rooms can't be accessed. Owain is in south Wales to see a sizeable unit with lots of development potential. In Lincolnshire, Dion is doing all he can to escape the rain!

videos.title: FA Women's Super League
videos.description: Live coverage of The Football Association Women's Super League (FA WSL), presently known as the Barclays FA Women's Super League, the most prestigious league of women's football in England. Follow exciting sporting action from the matches, featuring 12 professional teams from across England, from Arsenal to West Ham United, competing to become Super League champions. The top three teams further qualify for the UEFA Women's Champions League.

videos.title: Flog It!
videos.description: This edition of Flog It! comes from Longleat in Wiltshire, home to the world-famous safari park and 16th-century Longleat House. In this rather special show, Paul Martin is joined by experts Michael Baggott and Claire Rawle. Whilst picking out a selection of interesting antiques and collectables to be sold at a local auction, Claire spots an unusual Tibetan teapot. This leads to the momentous discovery of other of Tibetan artefacts belonging to the same owner, a collection of controversial historical significance which all ends up going under the hammer. With worldwide interest in these object

videos.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
videos.description: In the fourth leg, the teams enter a new frontier, Australia. The sixth largest country on the planet and home to eight distinct climate zones, it's a land of extreme contrasts. Language barriers may have evaporated, but in their place is a new challenge, the budget, as the country delivers all teams a financial reality check. The teams descend on the fourth checkpoint in the tightest race yet, with a foot race to the sign-in book.

videos.title: This Farming Life
videos.description: Spring is in the air, bringing newborn livestock. In North Uist, Carianne spends her days on the tiny island of Vallay in search of new Highland calves. When one calf is discovered without a mother, Carianne must turn detective to reunite them. In Inverkip, Rachel and Camy are heading to the hills to help any of their Cheviot sheep in need of a midwife. And in South Ayrshire, the Barclay family are working round the clock to ensure their flock of Beltex ewes safely deliver this year's crop of lambs.

videos.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
videos.description: Eva takes a boat trip down the Seine with chef Eric Ripert and writer Lindsey Tramuta. Together, they explore the story of French gastronomy through a seven-course fine dining meal. At the heart of this delicious story is one man – Auguste Escoffier. He dominated every aspect of gastronomy, inventing and improving hundreds of classic dishes, bringing order to chaos in the kitchen with his military-style brigade and revolutionising front of house. Escoffier put French haute cuisine on the global map.

videos.title: Ireland with Simon Reeve
videos.description: Starting at the spectacular Giant's Causeway in Northern Ireland, Simon travels down the east coast to the great and rapidly changing cities of Belfast and Dublin. He ends his journey in the stunning Wicklow Mountains.

videos.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
videos.description: Paul and Bob travel to County Tyrone to fish at Baronscourt Estate, hoping to catch a pike of a lifetime. They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of one rowing boat – what could possibly go wrong? Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey. Bob has a fail-safe method to try, but will the duo be able to outwit the elusive creatures?

videos.title: A Course Called Ireland
videos.description: After weeks of travelling, filming and constant attention, life on the road is taking its toll on Bill. With brothers Joel and Johnny along for the ride, family offers an escape from fame. The Murrays reflect on losing their father young, and how caddying and golf bound nine siblings together. By the time they reach Cruit Island in Donegal, family reflection gives way to golfing rivalry.

videos.title: Uncanny
videos.description: Lindsey and her family move to a new-build house on the Isle of Thanet in Kent. For years, they live there happily, but then their quiet lives are suddenly rocked by a series of terrifying events: repeated footsteps every night, door handles that move by themselves and the appearance of a cloaked, hunched, shadowy figure. Who is the figure? Could the answers lie beneath their feet?

videos.title: Get Out
videos.description: Chris and his girlfriend Rose head to upstate New York to meet her parents for the first time. When they arrive, Rose's parents are genial and welcoming to him, but the more time he spends with them and their quiet, obedient servants, the more Chris feels that something is very, very wrong.

videos.title: Blood
videos.description: Sibling detectives Joe and Chrissie are on the hunt for 12-year-old Angela's murderer. One drunken night, feeling frustrated by the case and over-protective of his own daughter Miriam, Joe along with Chrissie drives the prime suspect Jason Burleigh into the woods and kills him. A reworking of Bill Gallagher's hard hitting thriller for the big screen.

videos.title: Highland Cops
videos.description: Police investigate the disappearance of a young monk from a monastery on a remote private island in Orkney. The mystery deepens when there appears to be no evidence of how he could have left the island. In Aviemore, a rock festival erupts into violence. In Inverness, officers hunt a man after a woman is attacked in a cemetery, while campers in Fort William take a wrong turn.

videos.title: Countryfile
videos.description: Hamza Yassin heads to a secret location in Scotland's Southern Uplands to join a dedicated team on an exciting mission to protect the fastest animal in the world – the peregrine falcon. Getting up close to three chicks, he discovers how DNA sampling is helping tackle the theft of these remarkable birds. Along the way, the programme revisits memorable Countryfile wildlife encounters, from dolphins off Anglesey to spectacular starling murmurations at Newport Wetlands.

videos.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
videos.description: By the start of the new millennium, the three chefs had changed British dining forever. This episode follows what happens when the rivalry that made them gets harder to walk away from than to feed, and brings them together for the first time in decades, exploring how each man handled the success he had fought for. Will time have healed old wounds, or will old rivalries still burn brightly?

videos.title: This Is BBC Two
videos.description: Regardez ce lundi 23 novembre sur BBC2 à 04:25 le programme "This Is BBC Two" produit en Ecossais en 2026. D'une durée de 185 min ce programme est adapté à tous publics.

videos.title: Bargain Hunt
videos.description: Eric Knowles visits Nottingham's Gothic revival cathedral to learn how conservators are revealing 19th-century artwork under decades of plaster and paint. Designed in 1842 by architect Augustus Pugin, the cathedral's interior was whitewashed in the 1960s. Pugin is widely admired for his work on some of Britain's most famous buildings, including the Palace of Westminster. Conservator Ana Logreira shows Eric how they are using digitally created stencils to renovate the cathedral's historic interior. At Southwell Racecourse in Nottinghamshire, red team uncle and niece Russ and Lily are up against

videos.title: Blue Planet III
videos.description: In the frozen waters of the Arctic, a bowhead whale breaks the sea ice with its skull to breathe – completely at home in this seemingly hostile sea. Polar waters may seem remote, but their influence supports more than the wildlife that thrives there by helping to power a global system of ocean currents that creates extraordinary opportunities for wildlife far beyond the ice. In the Falkland Islands, nutrient-rich water flowing north from Antarctica sustains a colony of king penguins. But returning parents weighed down with food for their chicks must try to cross a beach patrolled by an extraor

videos.title: Match of the Day
videos.description: Highlights of Sunday's two Premier League games as Liverpool take on Manchester United at Anfield and high-flying Brighton go to Hull City, a first league meeting between the two teams since 2016 when both were in the Championship. Kelly Cates presents.

videos.title: BBC News
videos.description: The latest news from the BBC,which is designed to inform you on current affairs. The BBC is aims to be a totally impartial public service broadcaster, and was established by Royal Charter. The BBC is funded by a licence fee paid by British households, and is regulated by Ofcom. They aim to create high-quality content, in order to inform and educate, but also entertain, their audience Millions of people from all over the world watch content produced by the BBC, and they are well respected as a media company. It was founded in 1922, with its headquarters in Westminster, London.

videos.title: Politics Live
videos.description: Join presenter Jo Coburn as she discusses the latest political news and stories in a conversational format, covering the comings-and-goings from Westminster in the BBC's daily politics programme. Featuring opinions and arguments from all the sides of the political spectrum, the show invites informed and opinionated guests to share their views on the stories of the day. Andrew Neil presents a special edition of the show on Wednesdays, with live coverage of Prime Minister's Questions followed by analysis and reaction, dissecting all the important topics from the weekly House of Commons event.

videos.title: Impossible
videos.description: Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

videos.title: Bridge of Lies
videos.description: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, family and friends Amy, JP, Nic and Alan – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money, step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just ha

videos.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
videos.description: Colin Murray discovers a brown sauce revival and the advantages of getting fish from a fishmonger as he visits Derry/Londonderry's Walled City Market. Briony May Williams explores how Somerset is rivalling France in cheese productions, and Onkar Singh Purewal discovers the secrets of beekeeping. Chef Julie Lin is in Dundee, finding out how bakers keep up with demand around the clock.

videos.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
videos.description: The stunning coastline of Northumberland is the setting for Michael Portillo's rail adventure from the city of Newcastle to England's northernmost town, Berwick-upon-Tweed. Travelling aboard the metro, the East Coast Main Line and the Tyne Valley line, Michael marvels at the scenery and admires the architectural and engineering legacy of the railways in the region where they were invented. His route takes in the River Tyne, Hadrian's Wall, a former mining village and the fishing port of Amble. Along the way, Michael visits Bamburgh Castle and the holy island of Lindisfarne. In Tynemouth, Micha

videos.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
videos.description: Three hundred thousand square miles of ocean. Three GPS-tracked voyages, filmed around the clock. One week at sea. Storm Arwen hits the UK, with the potential to affect the country's entire fishing fleet. In the North Sea, pair trawlers Victory Rose and Our Lass must come together each time they haul, making them vulnerable to collision in bad weather. As the storm approaches and grows, the boats start to roll, and James has to decide whether to take shelter in Shetland – where he and his fish could be trapped for days – or steam back to harbour in Peterhead to land what fish they have. Four h

videos.title: Antiques Roadshow
videos.description: Antiques valuation programme. A team of well-respected experts travel around the UK visiting a string of beautiful locations such as castles, stately homes, mansions, gardens and museums. They are met by members of the public who have brought along an antique, family heirloom or curio, eager for a current valuation. The experts have their own specialisms and are always on the lookout for a surprise discovery among the artwork, furniture, jewellery, silver, books, clothing and more. The entertainment comes from the conversations about the histories of the more interesting items, and the suspens

videos.title: Flog It!
videos.description: This episode comes from Oxford Union, right in the heart of central Oxford. Paul Martin is joined by experts Christina Trevanion and Will Axon. Together the team pick out a selection of interesting antiques and collectables to be sold at a local auction. Will uncovers some salacious etchings by a very famous artist, while Christina finds a unique autograph book, but will it reach for the stars or languish at the bottom of the bill? Paul also gets the chance to explore behind the scenes at Oxford Union to discover a few of the famous faces who debated in the chamber.

videos.title: House of Games
videos.description: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard?

videos.title: Strictly It Takes Two
videos.description: A British television programme, the companion show to the popular BBC One programme Strictly Come Dancing. Originally the show was presented by Claudia Winkleman, then by Zoe Ball, and finally Rylan Clark-Neal is announced to join the show as a co-host. The hosts interview the dancers competing in the main Saturday night show and celebrities, as well as the judges and celebrity fans to see what they think of the couples' performances. The show features the footage from the rehearsal rooms and exclusive behind-the-scenes gossip.

videos.title: Global Eye
videos.description: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. In this episode: Nomsa Maseko reports from South Africa, where a series of shocking murders has exposed the dangers that women face. Plus BBC Eye reveals new evidence showing how scouts, agencies and powerful fashion figures helped Jeffrey Epstein gain access to young women after his conviction for sex offences. And B

videos.title: Mastermind
videos.description: In another heat, four contenders take on the famous black chair, answering questions on their chosen specialist subjects to earn a place in the semi-finals. Clive Myrie hosts and asks questions on Marilyn Monroe, the influential author Katherine Mansfield, the award-winning television series The Sopranos and the German mathematician Carl Friedrich Gauss.

videos.title: Only Connect
videos.description: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts the quiz where knowledge only gets you so far – the vital extra ingredients are logic and lateral thinking. It's another rematch: these teams may know each other from before, but they'd better not drop their guard, because the questions are ramping up. For example: what connects Toe Martin, Shadow Fury, Tonsil Draper and Jiminy Stokes?

videos.title: University Challenge
videos.description: Long-running general knowledge quiz that tests the intellectual powers of the brightest undergraduates in Britain. Launched in 1962 and hosted by Bamber Gascoigne, the show achieved cult status with teams from two different rival colleges pitting their wits against each other each week. The questions are as varied and as tough as they can be, and competitors risk having hard-earned points deducted with each incorrect response. videos.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
videos.description: Lucy Worsley travels to Venice, where she is given the keys to the Doge's Palace, a multi-purpose building that controlled Venice's empire for a thousand years. She has a close shave in the dreaded Council of Ten's torture chamber, discovers a 24-carat gold staircase that leads to one of the biggest rooms in Europe, and encounters hidden doors and secret messages.

videos.title: Peelers: The PSNI For Real
videos.description: In Portadown, Lee and Sarah keep a careful watch as the pubs and clubs spill out. A man harangues Stephen, accusing him of refusing to take his own mother to the bingo. Eventually, he is sent packing, and Stephen reveals his mother does not play bingo. Back in Belfast, Jade, Tom, Perri and Adam spot a row outside shops where young people say their money has been stolen by a woman. CCTV suggests the man she is with may also have headbutted a passer-by. The man violently resists arrest, fighting, spitting and shouting sectarian abuse at Tom and Adam.
